32.text: This description shows well how strong may be the desire of the master

33.text: to have a new neighbor and assistant for the care of the herd. Of course,

34.text: it gives the ideal conditions of such relations. It will be noted that the rich

35.text: reindeer-owner and the poor new-comer meet in this tale on a quite equal

36.text: footing, and then they live rather as two brothers than as master and dependent.
